item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 01/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon, the weather will be rather cool in the morning over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. The monsoon is expected to maintain fine and dry weather over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to midweek next week. It will still be cool in the morning. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nyatoh will move across the western North Pacific in the next couple of days, then towards the seas south of Japan.
